plain: Having to do with the church and its officers

webster.text: Pertaining or relating to the church; as ecclesiastical discipline or government; ecclesiastical affairs, history or polity; ecclesiastical courts.

example.quote: Because experience witnesseth that ecclesiastical establishments, instead of maintaining the purity and efficacy of Religion, have had a contrary operation.
example.cite: James Madison, Memorial and Remonstrance Against Religious Assessments, c. June 20, 1785
